Jakub Novak  
Czech Republic | +420 123 456 789 | j.novak@cybershieldtech.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/jakubnovak | GitHub: github.com/jakubnovak  

Professional Experience  
As a Senior Full-Stack Cybersecurity Developer at CyberShield Technologies, I’ve spearheaded the integration of advanced threat detection systems that reduced false positives by 37% across enterprise networks. Prior to this, I led the migration of security protocols at DefendCore Inc., where I redesigned authentication workflows using Python and REST APIs, improving system response times by 28%. My earlier role as a Junior Software Developer at SecureNet Solutions laid the groundwork for my career, where I contributed to the development of a proprietary encryption module using Go, which became a cornerstone of the company’s data protection strategy.  

Technical Skills  
My expertise spans full-stack development with a focus on cybersecurity. I’ve architected secure backend systems using Go, delivering a real-time intrusion detection platform that processed over 10 million logs daily. Python remains central to my work, particularly in automating vulnerability assessments that slashed manual testing hours by 40%. REST API design is my specialty, with a recent project involving the creation of a microservices-based security analytics dashboard that integrated with AWS services for scalable data processing. React powers the front-end of several critical tools, including a threat intelligence portal with over 50,000 active users. Rust has been instrumental in building high-performance components for secure communication protocols, while Docker ensures seamless containerization of security applications across hybrid environments. Kubernetes is occasionally leveraged for orchestrating distributed security workloads, though my primary focus remains on cloud-native solutions.  

Education  
Master’s in Cybersecurity, Brno University of Technology, 2018. Thesis: “Adaptive Encryption Algorithms for Cloud-Based Threat Intelligence,” which explored dynamic key management strategies now used in multiple client projects.  

Projects  
1. **CyberShield Threat Detection Suite**: Developed a real-time analytics platform using Go and Python, integrating AWS Lambda for event-driven security monitoring. The system reduced incident response times by 32% and was deployed across 12 enterprise clients.  
2. **Secure API Gateway**: Designed a REST API framework for a financial institution, incorporating OAuth 2.0 and rate-limiting mechanisms that prevented 15,000+ unauthorized access attempts monthly.  
3. **Zero Trust Architecture Implementation**: Led the migration of a multinational corporation’s network to a zero-trust model, leveraging React for a user-facing dashboard and Rust for secure inter-service communication.  
4. **Automated Penetration Testing Tool**: Built a Python-based tool that streamlined vulnerability scanning, reducing manual effort by 50% and identifying critical misconfigurations in 20+ client environments.  

Languages  
English (native), German (professional working), French (business fluent), Spanish (basic conversational).  

Volunteer / Open Source  
Contributor to the Open Cybersecurity Foundation’s Threat Hunter Toolkit, where I implemented a Docker-based containerization solution for rapid deployment of security modules. Regularly mentor junior developers at local tech meetups, focusing on secure coding practices and cloud integration strategies. Also maintain a GitHub repository for open-source security scripts that has garnered over 5,000 stars, with recent contributions including a Python-based log analysis tool used by 30+ security teams globally.
